description: Alliant Energy maintains its principal executive offices in Madison, Wisconsin, and operates as a regulated investor-owned public utility holding company whose purpose-driven strategy is to serve its customers and build stronger communities. Its primary focus is providing regulated electric and natural gas service to approximately 1,010,000 electric and approximately 435,000 natural gas customers in the Midwest through two public utility subsidiaries, IPL and WPL. IPL is engaged principally in the generation and distribution of electricity and the distribution and transportation of natural gas to retail customers in select markets in Iowa, serving approximately 505,000 electric and 230,000 natural gas retail customers at December 31, 2025.
